note: House rules for Bell Curve GURPS. Costs are already x10. Not GURPS RAW.

traits.name: Backstabber
traits.summary: Against an unaware target, hit-location penalties are halved (fractions kept). Applies to ranged attacks too unless the character sets options.backstabber to "melee".

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.summary: +1d injury per level against an unaware target, added after the hit-location multiplier. Level cap is 2 or 3 (undecided); the validator allows 3.
